name: Panorama Camping Harras
beschreibung: The Panorama Camping Harras is located in Prien am Chiemsee in Bayern and offers a location with a view of the surrounding mountain landscape. The campsite is situated near the Chiemsee, one of the largest lakes in Deutschland, and is surrounded by the nature of the Chiemgau-Alpenvorland. Guests will find pitches for motorhomes and tents that have basic utility connections. The facility has sanitary facilities, a kiosk, and opportunities for local recreation by the lake. The surroundings offer access to hiking trails in the Bayerischen Alpen and excursion options to the Insel Herrenchiemsee with its royal palace. In winter, ski areas in the Bavarian Alpine region are reachable by car. The site is suitable for seasonal and transit guests who are looking for a nature-oriented accommodation on the Chiemsee.
